coverage_limitations: Vanilla entity files are behavior definitions, not complete mob gameplay guides.
resource_pack/blocks.json is a visual registry, not a complete block mechanics database.
behavior_pack/blocks entries are limited to blocks represented in the sample pack; do not assume every vanilla block is defined there.
Spawning, drops, and loot may live in separate files; link with existing extracted databases.
Wiki explanations still needed for mob weaknesses, breeding foods, block uses, redstone, and survival advice.
